results.content: YouGov polls about 1,500 members of its national opt-in panel weekly using online questionnaires. State-level approval rates are “estimated” based on demographic characteristics, voting behavior, the state’s voting history and other data. Nationally, YouGov’s tracker shows 34% approving of Trump’s job performance and 61% disapproving, for a net approval rating of -27.

Methodology

Each week, YouGov invites around 1,500 members of its opt-in panel to complete an online questionnaire. The respondents are selected to be representative of American adult citizens and the data is weighted to represent the country according to gender, age, race, education and voting behaviour. To track the results of YouGov’s polling over time, The Economist aggregates survey data each week and fits a line of best fit. # Trump poll finds most states disapprove of his job performance

Portrait of Natassia Paloma

Most states disapprove of President Donald Trump’s job performance, including Texas.

According to an approval tracker from The Economist and YouGov, Trump’s net job approval rating in Texas is -22, meaning his disapproval rating is 22 percentage points higher than his approval rating.

Texas is far from alone. [...] The tracker shows 47 of the 50 states with negative net approval ratings for Trump. Only three states have positive net approval ratings for the president: Wyoming at +14, Idaho at +9 and West Virginia at +6.
